assertions: two servers times two tools per server times four harnesses times two trials produce 32 cases
every execution completes and records its selected tool call, server, arguments, success, and structured result

network: The MCP servers use local stdio. Native agents make provider requests and may incur charges.
credentials: Each adapter needs its own configured provider credentials. Values are referenced from environment variables and are not printed.
cleanup: MCPTestKit closes agent and server processes after test execution.
verification_mode: live-provider; not run in this development preview
